scope.summary: OCIDs embedded in operator-facing prose are now redacted: the doctor/error surface previously scrubbed only known-secret substrings (redact_exact_substrings), so an OCI/Oracle error quoting a tenant/resource OCID we never held to match exactly passed through into doctor detail/fix text and log lines. A narrow prose scanner (redact_ocids) mirrors the telemetry crate's proven recognizer — requires the documented ocid1.<type>.<realm> minimum, token-boundary anchored, trailing sentence punctuation excluded — and is composed into the surface scrub.
out_of_scope: the doctor.rs composition site (calls the new redact_ocids; the recognizer itself is the fix and lives in redacted.rs)

entry_points.name: redact_ocids prose scanner
entry_points.trace: crates/oraclemcp-core/src/redacted.rs adds redact_ocids, a token-boundary-anchored ocid1.<type>.<realm> recognizer mirroring the telemetry recognizer, composed into the doctor/error prose scrub so quoted OCIDs no longer reach doctor detail/fix text or log lines. Landed in bc061ae9 (source and last-touch of redacted.rs). cargo test -p oraclemcp-core.

limitations: Scoped regression proof only; full gate green in CI at HEAD 5031d67e. source.sha bc061ae9 is the last commit touching redacted.rs and where the recognizer landed.
